license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person in the state of Wyoming to practice or attempt to practice optometry or to advertise, or hold himself out as qualified to fit or adjust any lenses or lens in any manner or form as an aid to human eyesight, without first obtaining a license to practice optometry.

issuing_authority.value: Wyoming State Board of Examiners in Optometry
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Wyoming state board of examiners in optometry

name.value: Wyoming State Board of Examiners in Optometry
name.quote: The Wyoming state board of examiners in optometry is created to carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of this act.

type.quote: The Wyoming state board of examiners in optometry is created to carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of this act.

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited optometric school or college
degree_required.quote: The applicant shall be a graduate of an optometric school or college accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization which is recognized or approved by the council on postsecondary accreditation or the United States Department of Education (USDE) or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), or their successor agencies.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) or United States Department of Education (USDE)
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization which is recognized or approved by the council on postsecondary accreditation or the United States Department of Education (USDE) or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), or their successor agencies

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
exams.notes: Or any other examination specified by the board in rule
exams.quote: Any applicant for licensure under this act is required to pass the examination series administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry, or its successor agency, or any other examination specified by the board in rule.

interval_years.quote: Every optometrist who desires to continue the practice of optometry shall annually, on or before April 1, pay the board the required renewal fee.

required.quote: All optometrists shall take courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry for the utilization and application of new techniques, scientific and clinical advances, and achievements of research

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of optometry to an applicant who is currently licensed in another United States or Canadian jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements as Wyoming

requirements.value: Currently licensed in another US or Canadian jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements as Wyoming; must meet Wyoming requirements for licensure by endorsement and comply with standards set forth in board rules.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of optometry to an applicant who is currently licensed in another United States or Canadian jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements as Wyoming and who meets Wyoming requirements for licensure by endorsement. Applicants for licensure by endorsement shall comply with standards set forth in board rules.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person in the state of Wyoming to practice or attempt to practice optometry or to advertise, or hold himself out as qualified to fit or adjust any lenses or lens in any manner or form as an aid to human eyesight, without first obtaining a license to practice optometry.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a current license to practice optometry in this state issued by the board

title_protection.quote: The use of any other term by a person licensed under this act except the term "optometrist" or "doctor of optometry" to designate his profession

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person in the state of Wyoming to practice or attempt to practice optometry or to advertise, or hold himself out as qualified to fit or adjust any lenses or lens in any manner or form as an aid to human eyesight, without first obtaining a license to practice optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Loaning license, employing cappers/steerers, fee splitting, or false/misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The loaning of his license by any licensed optometrist to any person; the employment of "cappers" or "steerers" to obtain business, "splitting" or dividing a fee with any person or persons, the advertising by any means whatsoever of optometric practice or treatment or advice in which untruthful, improbable, misleading or impossible statements are made

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offenses related to optometric practice or habitual intemperance or addiction to drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of offenses that relate to the practice of optometry or to the ability to practice optometry or involving habitual intemperance, or being habitually addicted to the use of morphine, opium, cocaine, or other drugs having a similar effect

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by intentional fraud, misrepresentation, or false pretenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of any fee by intentional fraud or intentional misrepresentation or false pretenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using any term other than 'optometrist' or 'doctor of optometry' to designate the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any other term by a person licensed under this act except the term "optometrist" or "doctor of optometry" to designate his profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform optometric work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing either directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work covered by the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making any false statement of material fact in any application or instrument filed with the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any false statement of any material fact in any application or other instrument required by law to be filed with the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely submit a renewal application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may suspend, revoke or refuse to issue a license to any person who has been guilty of unprofessional and dishonest conduct, unethical conduct, conduct likely to deceive the public or failure to timely submit a renewal application.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry occurs when a person employs primary human eye care procedures, including: the examination, diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions and diseases of the eye, its adnexa and visual system; measuring the powers and range of vision of the eye; the adaptation, sale, prescribing and dispensing of frames and ophthalmic lenses; ordering and performance of diagnostic laboratory or imaging tests; the prescribing and administration of pharmaceutical agents; preoperative and postoperative care; and any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry occurs when a person employs primary human eye care procedures, including:

value: examination, diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions and diseases of the eye, its adnexa and visual system
measuring the powers and range of vision of the eye
adaptation, sale, prescribing and dispensing of frames and ophthalmic lenses
ordering and performance of diagnostic laboratory or imaging tests
prescribing and administration of pharmaceutical agents
laser procedures as set forth by board rules
methods_authorized.quote: The examination, diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions and diseases of the eye, its adnexa and visual system; Measuring the powers and range of vision of the eye to determine the accommodative and refractive state and general function of the eye; The adaptation, sale, prescribing and dispensing of frames and ophthalmic lenses in all their forms; Ordering and performance of diagnostic laboratory or imaging tests; The prescribing and administration of pharmaceutical agents, as provided in W.S. 33-23-102; Preoperative and postoperative care for those procedures excluded from the practice of optometry under subsection (c) of this section; Any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules and not excluded under subsection (c) of this section.

drug_authority.value: May administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease, excluding schedule I and II narcotics, but allowing hydrocodone or hydrocodone-containing agents regardless of schedule.
drug_authority.quote: An optometrist shall be allowed to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease, excluding schedule I and II narcotics, but allowing for the prescribing of hydrocodone or hydrocodone containing pharmaceutical agents regardless of schedule.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The following ophthalmic procedures shall be excluded from the authorized practice of optometry

surgery_definition.value: Excluded procedures include surgery with general anesthesia, removal of an eye, surgery of the bony orbit, incisional/excisional surgery of extraocular muscles, eyelid surgery for malignancies or cosmetic/mechanical repair, lacrimal system surgery, full thickness conjunctivoplasty, pterygium surgery, full thickness incision/excision of cornea or sclera (except emergency paracentesis), corneal transplants, iris/ciliary body incision, crystalline lens extraction, intraocular implants, vitreous removal, retinal/macular procedures including intravitreal injection, retinal manipulation, and intravenous injections.
surgery_definition.quote: Surgery related to removal of an eye from a living person; Surgery of the bony orbit, including orbital implants; Incisional or excisional surgery of the extraocular muscles; Surgery of the eyelid for suspected malignancies or for incisional cosmetic or mechanical repair of blepharochalasis, ptosis or tarsorrhaphy

value: Any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules and not excluded under subsection (c)
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: Any laser procedure as set forth by the board's rules and not excluded under subsection (c) of this section.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: An optometrist shall be allowed to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease

value: Hydrocodone or hydrocodone-containing agents allowed regardless of schedule
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: excluding schedule I and II narcotics, but allowing for the prescribing of hydrocodone or hydrocodone containing pharmaceutical agents regardless of schedule

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: An optometrist shall be allowed to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist shall be allowed to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents related to the practice of optometry for the treatment of ocular disease

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Nothing in this act shall prevent an optometrist from using assistants in his practice under his general supervision as defined in board rule.

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: An optometrist shall provide, at no additional cost to the patient, a written copy of his contact lens prescription.

retired_license_status_available.quote: An optometrist who previously notified the board that he had retired may renew his license by submitting renewal fees for each year in which no license was issued and a reinstatement fee within three (3) years of the expiration date of the last license held. Upon retirement from active practice, an optometrist shall notify the board in writing.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: an applicant for licensure under this act shall provide the board fingerprints and other information necessary for a criminal history record background check as provided under W.S. 7-19-201.
